langCode.description: Arayüz dilinin kodu (ülke adları ve sıralama için)

extDescription.message: Export your saved WhatsApp Web contacts to CSV and VCF in one click. Your data never leaves your computer.

privacy.message: Your data never leaves your computer

optUnsaved.message: Also include numbers not saved in your contacts

countryNote.message: Numbers from other countries stay in international format. VCF always uses international format.

optExcel.message: I'll open the CSV in Excel

hint.message: Send the VCF file to your phone and open it to add all contacts at once.

errNotWaBody.message: This tab isn't WhatsApp Web. Open web.whatsapp.com, wait for your chats to load, then click the extension icon again.

retry.message: Reload the page and try again.

errLoginTitle.message: You don't seem to be signed in

errLoginBody.message: WhatsApp Web isn't signed in or hasn't finished loading. Sign in with the QR code, wait until your chats appear, then try again.

errNoDataBody.message: WhatsApp Web may have changed its structure. If you send the technical details below to the developer, it can be fixed.

errNoSavedBody.message: $TOTAL$ records were read, but none of them has a name from your address book. Do you want to include unsaved numbers too?

loadingSlow.message: WhatsApp Web seems busy (it may still be syncing your chats). This can take a few seconds…

errSlowBody.message: WhatsApp Web is probably still syncing. Wait until your chats have finished loading, then try again. If it keeps happening, reload the WhatsApp Web tab.
